EVERY DANCER STARTS SOMEWHERE

Your first eight counts.

Curious about swing? Start with a beginner-friendly class and discover how good moving to jazz can feel.

01

Look for a beginner class

An introductory Lindy Hop or solo jazz class is a lovely way to begin. Check the teacher’s class description for experience requirements.

02

Bring your curiosity

Wear comfortable clothes and shoes you can move in. Ask the organiser about indoor shoes and whether you need to bring a partner.

03

Listen for the swing

Try listening to Count Basie or Ella Fitzgerald. Notice the pulse and let your feet find it.

Local classes

Confirmed school and class recommendations will be added here. Please check each school’s own information before attending.
